The nose surgery took less than an hour, but the waiting list is quite long. I booked the 6999 baht nose surgery package and paid a 1000 baht deposit. Those who booked the package would have to pay this extra cost. This was a price the clinic didn't inform me about. So, I chose the standard pre-made silicone. The total price was 15990 baht. During the consultation, the doctor seemed to recommend artificial silicone for a more prominent nose, which would cost an additional 10000 baht, but it was up to the client. I didn't choose that option. The total cost was around 17000 baht. They injected local anesthetic during the procedure. It was probably the most painful part, but once it was numb, I didn't feel anything. The nurse was very helpful.
-I didn't get a nose evaluation beforehand, so I don't know this part. I recommend coming in for a consultation before doing anything. But the doctor did a great job; the results are beautiful and complete. They also took before and after photos. The medication you'll definitely get includes painkillers, anti-swelling medication, antibiotics, and some wound care supplies. This doesn't include the 990 baht cold pack, which is quite expensive. /I'm not sure if it's mandatory. But I did get it.
I bought a cold pack from a pharmacy outside for 90 baht per piece, just in case.
(I recommend consulting them beforehand, not going on the day of the procedure lol)
(The salesperson seemed a bit pushy.)
I give it 4 out of 5 stars.
